words.definition: To successfully complete something with effort or skill
words.example: She worked hard to achieve her goal of becoming a doctor.

words.definition: Lasting only a short period of time
words.example: We had a brief meeting before the project started.

words.definition: The ability to do something that frightens someone
words.example: It took a lot of courage to speak in front of the crowd.

words.definition: Having or showing care and conscientiousness in one's work
words.example: The diligent student studied vocabulary every evening.

words.definition: To travel around a new place to learn about it
words.example: They decided to explore the ancient city on foot.

words.definition: To pay particular attention to something
words.example: Please focus on your pronunciation during practice.

words.definition: The process of developing or maturing
words.example: Daily practice leads to steady growth in language skills.

words.definition: A settled or regular tendency or practice
words.example: Reading five minutes a day is an excellent habit.

words.definition: To fill someone with the urge or ability to do something creative
words.example: Her dedication inspired all the other students in the room.

words.definition: An act of traveling from one place to another
words.example: Learning a language is an exciting long-term journey.

words.definition: Facts, information, and skills acquired through experience or education
words.example: Books are an endless source of knowledge and wisdom.

words.definition: To give attention to sound or action
words.example: Listen carefully to native speakers to improve accent.

words.definition: The faculty by which the mind stores and remembers information
words.example: Flashcards strengthen your long-term memory for words.

words.definition: The physical world collective, including plants and animals
words.example: Taking a walk in nature refreshes the tired mind.

words.definition: A set of circumstances that makes it possible to do something
words.example: Do not miss the opportunity to practice English today.

words.definition: The capacity to accept delay or suffering without getting angry
words.example: Mastering vocabulary requires consistency and patience.

words.definition: Making little or no noise
words.example: Find a quiet room so you can study without distractions.

words.definition: Consistently good in quality or performance; able to be trusted
words.example: A good dictionary is a reliable tool for learners.

words.definition: Easily understood or done; presenting no difficulty
words.example: Start with simple sentences before writing complex essays.

words.definition: A quantity of precious items or a prized possession
words.example: Every new word you learn is a treasure for your communication.
